questions.question: A shaft rotates at 1750 rpm. What is its speed in revolutions per second?
questions.explanation: Divide rpm by 60 to convert to revolutions per second. 1750 ÷ 60 = 29.2 rps.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of lubrication in bearings and gears?
questions.explanation: Lubricants separate moving surfaces. This reduces metal-to-metal contact and extends component life.

questions.question: A spark test produces long yellow sparks with many forks. This usually indicates:
questions.explanation: Higher-carbon steels generally create more branching sparks. Spark testing helps identify ferrous metals.

questions.category: C8 — Perform heat treatment of metal
questions.question: What is the purpose of annealing steel?
options: Soften the metal and improve machinability
questions.explanation: Annealing reduces hardness and internal stresses. It makes material easier to machine or form.

questions.category: C9 — Use mechanical drawings and specifications
questions.question: A drawing shows Ø40 H7. What does this most likely mean?
options: 40 mm diameter hole with H7 tolerance
questions.explanation: The Ø symbol means diameter. H7 is a tolerance class commonly used for holes.
